cards.name: Blessed Respite
cards.oracleText: Target player shuffles their graveyard into their library. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn.

cards.name: Jaheira's Respite
cards.oracleText:
Search your library for up to X basic land cards, where X is the number of creatures attacking you, put those cards onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn.

cards.name: Tenuous Truce
cards.oracleText:
Enchant opponent
At the beginning of enchanted opponent's end step, you and that player each draw a card.
When you attack enchanted opponent or a planeswalker they control or when they attack you or a planeswalker you control, sacrifice this Aura.

cards.name: Truce
cards.oracleText: Each player may draw up to two cards. For each card less than two a player draws this way, that player gains 2 life.
